subject: Customer report: sections missing from LLM output — investigation
messages:
From: Alice Morin <alice@greenlinelabs.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Missing sections in completions (example attached)

Hi Naomi,

We started seeing a few completions from Redwood's API that drop entire sections of the expected output (we call them 'missing paragraphs'). It happens intermittently in a small subset of requests (approx 6/200 for us today). I attached an example where the second and third bullet are omitted in the returned text. Can you confirm if this is something on your side or something we should change in our client?

Attached: greenline_example_omitted_sections.txt (text/plain)

Thanks,
Alice Morin
Product, Greenline Labs

---
[greenline_example_omitted_sections.txt contains the customer's prompt and the returned completion with the gap around paragraph 2-3. ]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morin <alice@greenlinelabs.com>
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Missing sections in completions (example attached)

Hi Alice — thanks for the example and sorry for the trouble. I've looped in Diego from our incident response team and Marissa from customer success so we can triage quickly.

Couple quick asks to help us reproduce:
- Can you paste the exact request payload (model, max_tokens, temperature, top_p, any special system/user messages) and the SDK/HTTP client version?
- If possible, please share a pair of request/response logs (we attached a stub below if you prefer).

We will try to repro against the same model version and config. If we confirm a platform issue we'll share the root cause and remediation plan. If we can't reproduce, we'll explain likely client-side triggers and best practices to avoid it.

For now, I'll mark this as under investigation and keep you updated within 24 hours.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: request-logs-20260920.json (recommended format for logs: timestamp, request-id, model, prompt hash)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alice Morin <alice@greenlinelabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Missing sections in completions (example attached)

Hi all — quick update from triage. I replayed the customer's prompt against the same model family and a pinned model snapshot (gptx-std-202609) with the config you outlined in the attached logs. On our side we cannot reproduce the omission: the returned completion includes the expected bullets in 100/100 replays with the same seed variation and deterministic sampling disabled.

What I checked:
- model snapshot pinned in our catalog (gptx-std-202609) — consistent tokenization
- KV cache and streaming paths — no truncation observed at server boundary
- recent deploys/rollouts around the timestamp — none matching the request window

There are a few plausible client-side causes to rule out:
- client-side streaming assembly issues where partial events are dropped
- inadvertent truncation when concatenating streamed chunks or when reassembling on newline boundaries
- a proxy/gateway in the customer's infra that enforces a size limit or times out mid-stream

Alice — could you confirm whether you consume the streaming SSE/HTTP chunked data directly or through a proxy/SDK wrapper? If you can share one of the raw request-id headers from a problematic call we can trace that exact path in our logs and check for intermediary timeouts.

If we fail to find evidence in your request-id trace we'll issue a closure note describing our reproductions and recommendations. Happy to set up a short call to walk through capture steps.

Thanks,
Diego
Sr. Incident Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Morin <alice@greenlinelabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: support@greenlinelabs.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Missing sections in completions (example attached)

Hi Naomi/Diego — thanks for the quick investigation. We dug into our edge proxy and found one request (request-id: gl-req-0912) that timed out at a load balancer between our frontend and the service that assembles streamed chunks. I've attached the raw trace and the request id. Based on Diego's testing and our trace it looks like the problem sits in our stack (proxy timeout) not Redwood's runtime.

We'll adjust the proxy timeout and add a verification step for stream completeness in our SDK. Appreciate the prompt help — please consider this resolved from our side. If you want us to share a postmortem once we finish the internal fix we can loop you in.

Thanks,
Alice
